mods.title: ["3.0"] KASSETTE HUD/QOL V-SLICE
mods.description: Tired of installing a bunch of mods just to get what you consider essential? Introducing Kassette HUD, a modular HUD for the base game (V-Slice). Compatible with both PC and Mobile, it's designed so you can modify it to your liking with custom modules. It also brings along other features to improve your overall gameplay experience. NEW: The entire mod was built from scratch! It now supports a brand new system for skins, layouts, and much more. I am really very grateful for the support that this project has had, and to commemorate it, I have brought an update with several suggestions and bugfixes that I had been asked for. What's New & Fixed: Strumline Rewritten: The entire strumline positioning system has been rewritten to support most resolutions and prevent overlap. Mobile Navigation: Many issues with the touch navigation of the options menu have been fixed to make it easier to use on mobile devices. Doppelganger Bugfix: A minor bug has been fixed that caused a player's HealthBar to appear in doppelganger songs (such as Pico Pico Mix). Menu Crash Fix: The menu has been reworked to prevent Character Scripts loads from launching when the options menu is opened, which caused crashes. A UNIQUE DESIGN  Kassette HUD stands out by having a layout that doesn't look like any other HUD you know. You can customize it to your liking and add whatever you want, as long as it's for you and your friends. MODULAR, BEYOND LIMITS  My HUD is built on modules that depend on a custom API. A brand new "Skin Folders" system has been created, which will allow you to easily create your own skins for the mod or customize any skin however you like (it will continue to improve over time). Feel free to create skins or adapt my HUD for your own mod or a third-party mod, you are entirely free to do so (please read the RULES & DISCLAIMERS). AND KASSETTE HUD LITE:  A separate and lighter version with the absolute essentials for those looking for something more lightweight. This hud is compatible with GAMMOD. Play with AWESOME GAMEPLAY MODIFIERS WITHOUT DELETING UR CUSTOM HUD FEATURES: Score Bar (Full and Lite): A score bar with more info, such as your accuracy, Rank, FC tier, etc... COLORED HEALTHBAR: Added dynamic coloring support for the healthbar. Health Bar Positions: You can now choose to place the health bar on the right, the left, or in the center. Clean HUD Layout: A new layout has been added to provide a more compact experience without sacrificing features. Custom Discord RPC [PC ONLY]: A modifier has been added so you can customize how your Discord status appears while playing. Ghost Tapping: A custom module so you can play without getting your Score deducted when pressing keys with no notes. Ghost Sing: Dance to the rhythm of the music without worries. MIDDLESCROLL (Full and Lite): A great module to play with a centered strumline. Play however you like and choose how you want to see the opponent's notes, worry-free. SUBTITLES PLUS: Customize your subtitles in the most visual way you prefer. Forget about events; these are the same classic subtitles as always, just with a little disguise to look cooler, with srt format and cutscenes support. JUDGE COUNTER (Full and Lite): Monitor your playstyle, flex that you're a pro and hit only Sicks. ACCURACY ASCENDING: Gain aura with an accuracy counter that is always increasing as you play better. BREAK BAR: Don't worry about forgetting your part of the song, this little bar will tell you how much time you have to stretch and get ready. PAUSE COUNTDOWN: Prepare yourself with a bit more time before jumping back into the action, don't lose your combo! TimeBar (Full and Lite): I don't know why you’d want to know when the song ends, but hey, here it is! :D There are also mini versions available. FONTS, FONTS, AND MORE FONTS: Now you can choose ANY FONT. Yes, ANY FONT YOU WANT. Just install the .ttf or .otf file into the HUD's fonts folder to make your menu feel more personal. You can even use fonts from other mods you own! Song Name Intro: Just a new module that shows the title and artist in the song intro :D OPTIONS MENU: A menu so you can customize your gameplay intuitively. Categories have now been added to improve navigation! Low Detail Mode: Added to the options menu for users who have trouble running the normal menu. NITE MODE: Getting tired of so many colors? Apply a small dark filter to take care of your eyes, schedule the time you want. HITSOUND: Oh yeah... Hear feedback when you press a note and feel like a super pro. Note Fade: A new option has been added to display a fade when notes are just a few seconds away from playing. Hide Opponent Notes: Now you can hide the opponent strumline without middlescroll. HealthBar for Opponentless songs: Just a bar with 1 icon. Icon Positions: Added a new layout option to position the character icons at the far edges of the health bar (Corners) rather than tracking along the middle. OPPONENT STRUMLINE OPACITY: Options for Opponent Opacity adjust lol. [MOBILE ONLY] FALLING NOTES: Now you can view the opponent notes in mobile :D RULES & DISCLAIMERS: Kassette HUD allows you to create custom modules to adapt my HUD to your liking or for a mod that uses its own HUD, as well as making it possible to disable itself automatically for your mods. Kassette HUD must strictly be a dependency if you want to create Skins or custom modules for it. The redistribution of the integrated modules and especially the API (which is exclusive to this mod) is NOT allowed. Taking code or assets used in this HUD for other HUDs or mods is not allowed. Recreating this HUD or its aesthetics for another V-Slice mod or another engine is not allowed. If you find any bugs, please let me know in the comments or through any contact method you find on my profile. ENJOY AND HAVE FUN! EXTRA!! COMPATIBILITY MODULE FOR SKY REDUX   To showcase the HUD's capabilities with custom module integration, I have created a module that makes my HUD compatible with the Vs. Sky: REDUX Mod aesthetic. You can find it in the "sky_redux_ksshud" zip file. Just add it to the following path: "/scripts/modules/CustomModules" Note: Remember you must have Vs. Sky: REDUX Mod installed to use it. Thank you very much for the support of this project, soon I will be communicating new projects that I will be working on!

mods.description: Welcome to SONIC JAMJAMMIN' NEW WEEKTake on the World's Most Famous Hedgehog in WEEK SONIC, a 3-song original level with songs inspired by the rich soundtracks of Sonic CD, Sonic R,Sonic Adventure, and beyond! Revisit a classic locale, experience dazzling hand-drawn cutscenes, and rhyme at super-sonic speeds! Can you keep up?PLAYABLE SONIC CAMPAIGNDr. Eggman's got a new path to world domination-- the POWER of MUSIC! Using his greatest creation, METAL SONIC, the Doctor's taking over the city's musical culture to harness its unlimited musical power. What's worse... is that they're convinced METAL SONIC is the REAL SONIC! But Sonic's not the slacker type. Take back the city's music and clear Sonic's name through intricately crafted 'Sonic Mixes' of FNF's unforgettable soundtrack. With 10+ remixes lovingly created from the ground up, you can check out a fresh, distinct take on Friday Night Funkin's music inspired by New Jack Swing, RNB, 90's House, Rock, Hip Hop, Chiptune, and many more. Face off against the worst of the worst, bring Metal Sonic's reign to an end, and free the spirit of music in Sonic's campaign.GO FOR PERFECTWhen you're playing as Sonic, simply hitting all the notes won't be enough for those brag-worthy P ranks. On top of beating a song flawlessly, you'll need to style on your enemies with a brand new taunt system. After hitting a combo, you'll be able to chain taunts to the rhythm until your next turn. Pull off a sweet chain, and you'll get crazy bonuses that'll shoot you straight to the top! Every SICK note you hit gets added to your SCORE, so be sure to rack up enough for a massive score bonus at the end. Make a name for yourself on the charts as the most stylish MC alive!
